excerpts.line: If you plan to use VA education benefits or have questions about your eligibility under VACA, please contact the Veterans Resource Center (VRC) for assistance.
window: Eligible spouses and dependents of active-duty service members who are domiciled or stationed in California may qualify for resident tuition. In many cases, eligibility continues if the service member is transferred or retires while the student remains continuously enrolled.

Veterans may qualify for resident tuition or a nonresident tuition exemption under California law or the federal Veterans Access, Choice, and Accountability Act (VACA). Eligibility depends on your military service, discharge status, VA education benefits, and other applicable requirements.
If you plan to use VA education benefits or have questions about your eligibility under VACA, please contact the Veterans Resource Center (VRC) for assistance.
vets@barstow.edu Contact the Veterans Resource Center
Students requesting military residency benefits should complete the Military Affidavit and submit any required supporting documentation to Admissions & Records.

I'm using VA education benefits. Who should I contact?

If you have questions about VA education benefits, certification, or your eligibility under the Veterans Access, Choice, and Accountability Act (VACA), please contact the Veterans Resource Center (VRC). The VRC can help determine which benefits may apply to your situation and guide you through the certification process.
vets@barstow.edu Contact the Veterans Resource Center
If you have questions about military residency benefits, required documentation, or your eligibility, Admissions & Records is here to help.
